lesson: The strategy is consistently entering short positions into localized liquidity sweeps during extreme fear, failing to account for mean reversion potential. By prioritizing bearish structural alignment over oversold conditions, the system is repeatedly catching the bottom of short-term impulse moves.
adjustment: Require a confirmed bearish market structure break (MSB) on the 15m timeframe following a liquidity sweep before entering any short position.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less without a confirmed structural confirmation on the lower timeframe.
